main.description: Something a creative or a place offers, or needs, for a while: a recording engineer available for hire, off-peak rehearsal rates, a studio desk free for three months, 'looking for a drummer'. Separate from the profile because offers come and go. Pause and reopen an offer by changing `status` on the same record rather than deleting and recreating it, so links and history survive. Public by nature: carry links, never private contact details.

kind.description: Offering something, or looking for something. Readers should not display a record whose kind they do not recognise.

offeredBy.description: The place.profile this offer belongs to. Omit when the offer is from the repository holder's own creative.profile.

offerType.description: Advisory vocabulary: new types need no schema change.

title.description: One line, e.g. 'Mixing and mastering', 'Shared studio desk, Deptford'.

areas.description: Where the offer applies. Defaults, for readers, to the offering party's basedIn or place area.

remote.description: Can be done remotely or online.

status.description: Readers treat any value other than 'open' as not currently available.

validUntil.description: After this, readers treat the offer as closed whatever its status says, so stale offers drop out without anyone tidying up.

updatedAt.description: When status or content last changed. Lets readers show 'reopened 2 days ago' and sort by freshness.

createdAt.description: When this record was first stamped. The only immutable field: everything else may be revised by publishing a new commit.
